# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag (KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL / CAPABILITY-GAP) | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Verification Gap | ALL failing | Agent claims to verify but does not actually print/check values in the code. | BEHAVIORAL | STRUCTURE (Mandatory printing) |
| 2 | Answer Placement Errors | 560-12, 39046 | Agent misinterprets "put from X" or distributes a single value across a range inappropriately. | BEHAVIORAL | KNOWLEDGE (Precision guidance) |
| 3 | Logic / Value Mismatch | 267-18, 416-15, 43436, 9569 | Miscalculated values or wrong date formatting (e.g. m/dd/yyyy vs MM/dd/yyyy). | KNOWLEDGE / BEHAVIORAL | BEHAVIORAL (Verify step) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit — aim for MULTIPLE classes, incl. a NEW tool when a cluster needs one)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Verification Gap | STRUCTURE (Checklist) | prompt.md / task_template.md | Mandatory `print()` of all answer range values before saving. Forces the agent to see the values it wrote. | Yes (already passing tasks are correct) |
| Answer Placement Errors | KNOWLEDGE (Guidance) | prompt.md | Explicit guidance on interpreting "put from X" and handling single-value results in a range. | Yes (passing tasks already follow this) |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation/new-tool now does on those exact inputs)
- All failing tasks: Agent narrated "Verification" but wrote no `print` statements → new contract requires explicit `print()` in code.
- 560-12: put headers at I2 when told "put from I3" → "Answer Placement" guidance forces prioritization of explicit cell references.
- 39046: wrote total count into every cell of F2:F6 → "Answer Placement" guidance forces clarification on single-value distribution.

## Process & features used
- Diagnosis of failing trajectories.
- Clustering by root cause (Verification, Placement, Logic).
- Applied structural changes to force verification.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- Literal values requirement.
- Range coverage requirement.
- Use of `openpyxl`.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why — already-passing / needs gold / infra noise)
- Individual logic fixes for 267-18, 43436, etc., as the structural verification fix is expected to catch these.
